history.event: Claude refinement: 39 line(s) suggested — Main corrections: the lira sign is now 𝓎 (this manuscript's sign in CONVENTIONS.md, not ⫳); sum figures checked one by one; restored garbled words (rosso, ꝯtanti, giugno, ricoprire, calzina/rena, gliusci, maestro, opē, chasa) and dates (adi 7, 11, 27). | layout: l39: the box holds only the 𝓎 sign at the start of the l40 sum (it was read as '44'). It duplicates l40, so delete it or merge it into l40.; l32, l40, l41: these sums are separate boxes in the sums column. They belong to the entries ending at l31, l35 and l37.; l7, l9, l11, l14, l20, l21, l26, l28: the sum sits inside the text line's box, but on other lines it is a separate box, so the layout is inconsistent.; l36: a small 'st' above the initial E sits outside the box and is not transcribed.; l38: a catchword or note below the text block ('vol…'), not part of an entry. | doubts: l4: the folio reference after 'a' could be c̄ 35 or c̄ 25.; l8: the last word (delteriogo? del luogo?) is unclear.; l10: the day looks like arabic 11 (two strokes like 'u'), not roman ii. It fits the date order 5, 7, 11 May.; l13: alusicio and dela terre are uncertain.; l14: da melrto and ufitio are uncertain.; l18: delama is unclear.; l20: I could not tell whether ī comes before ꝯtanti.; l21: e brochi (nails?) is a guess for the word after aguti.; l25: remurare and ī terreno are uncertain.; l27: icalzinacci is uncertain.; l28: amato landi is uncertain, and so is the verb costorono.; l36: the word after adi is unclear: di or a short abbreviation.; l38: I could not read the word after 'vol'.; All sums: soldi are left as ß as Kraken read them. CONVENTIONS.md has an open question on ß vs β.
